commands.command: TBD: mine outcome-critical wrong-history candidates directly with source-diversity constraints before another objective or PPO run
commands.name: m120_outcome_critical_source_diverse_miner

decision_rule: Admit a new training surface only if outcome-critical wrong-history rows are discovered across enough physical pairs, targets, and boundary buckets before objective training.
failure_criteria: accepted rows still collapse to the 9530/9540 physical source pairs
wrong-history degradation appears only after post-hoc duplicate-heavy boundary tuning
reset or zero-current response remains the only source-diverse outcome signal
M62 is admitted as a wrong-history outcome-critical policy
hypothesis: M119 shows source-diverse matched-current action ambiguity is not enough: outcome-critical wrong-history rows still collapse to a few old physical pairs. A miner that optimizes for outcome criticality and source diversity directly may produce a usable self-identification training surface.
success_criteria: candidate generation or selection explicitly accounts for physical-pair diversity before post-hoc robustness
wrong-history outcome degradation is measured, not only first-action distance
accepted rows cover at least 6 physical source pairs, 5 left steps, 3 target groups, and 2 normal-margin buckets
the result decides whether a wrong-history outcome objective is admissible
